legal.title: Privacy and Data Protection Policy
legal.subtitle: Compliance with the General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018)
legal.s1b: We collect only the data strictly necessary for the system to work, including: name, corporate e-mail, CPF, date of birth, phone, legal guardian data, enrollment information and health data (physical assessments and BMI) for educational purposes.
legal.s2b: Data is used exclusively for: educational and academic performance monitoring, attendance control, physical and vocational assessments, administrative management, and compliance with legal and regulatory obligations.
legal.s3b1: Consent (Art. 7, I) — for general personal data
legal.s3b2: Specific consent for health data (Art. 11) — physical assessments
legal.s3b4: Legal obligation (Art. 7, II) — when required by law
legal.s4b: Data is not shared with third parties without express consent, except when required by law or court order. We only use the hosting service (Supabase), which follows international security standards.
legal.s5b: We adopt technical and organizational measures to protect data, including: transmission encryption (SSL/TLS), encryption of sensitive data at rest, password hashing with bcrypt, role-based access control (RBAC), and access logs (audit logs).
legal.s6b: Data is kept while the school/contractual relationship lasts. After that, data is deleted or anonymized, unless retention is required to comply with a legal obligation.
legal.s7b1: Confirm that your data is being processed
legal.s7b3: Correct incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data
legal.s7b4: Anonymize, block or delete unnecessary data
legal.s7b6: Deletion of data processed with consent
legal.s8b: To exercise your rights or clarify doubts, contact our Data Protection Officer:
